# sh

Run the supported shell language through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/sh -c 'printf "%s\n" hello'

moonx cli/sh script.sh
```

Execute a command string, a script file or stdin. Supports variables, redirections, pipelines, control flow, arithmetic and builtins in the documented profile.

| `-c VALUE` | Execute source text. |
| `-s` | Read commands from stdin. |
| `-i` | Enable explicit interactive prompts and ENV startup. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Compatible with the MoonBit 2026-11-17 toolchain.

- This is not a complete POSIX shell or Bash implementation. Descriptor, terminal, permission and file-identity operations have explicit limits.
- External commands require launcher permission; shell evaluation itself uses the MoonBit implementation.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
